title: Framer
previewIntro: The icon appears here once a URI is entered.
heading: Frame a web application
sub: Creates a new cvwm app that frames a web page. The app is written to /apps/ and opens like any other.
uriHint: The page must allow being framed from this desktop (its frame-ancestors / origin allow-list).
nameHint: Letters, digits, - and _; becomes the container name under /apps/.
noFavicon: No favicon could be saved; the generic icon will be used.
iconFromServer: Icon fetched by the server (HTTP import).
faviconNoCors: The favicon can be shown but not read (no CORS); the generic icon will be saved.
invalidName: The name may hold letters, digits, - and _, and must not start with - or _.
noDisk: No disk is mounted to write the app to.
